runSummary.note: Real 16 Sep 21:18 sweep. Twelve independent source families were actually queried: Profesia, direct company/public careers, LinkedIn Jobs, Worki, Kariera, Brigada.sk, Praca za rohom, Pretlak/StartupJobs, Upwork, WordPress public jobs, Reddit/WordPress communities, and public Facebook indexing. LinkedIn surfaced Wolt Support Associate in Bratislava: full-time remote after one office training day, EUR 1,270 gross, but minimum B2 English plus morning/evening/weekend shifts materially reduce fit. Upwork surfaced current WooCommerce work, but the best operational listing is three weeks old with 20-50 proposals and one hire, while fresher technical roles require advanced PHP/server skills or native English. Reddit result was seven months old and only $2-4/h. Facebook produced 0 concrete publicly verifiable posts.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Shift-window fit score
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Normalize required coverage windows, weekends and evening work into a separate fit penalty so nominally remote customer-support roles do not outrank daytime jobs that better support family and KomArena work.

masterBacklogAdditions.title: Marketplace client-recency decay
masterBacklogAdditions.detail: Combine posting age with last-viewed, interviews and hires into an actionability decay score; automatically demote listings where the client has gone inactive or hiring is already substantially underway even if the post remains technically open.

policy.contentAgeVsVerificationAge: updatedAt/contentUpdatedAt describes data-content age; sourceVerificationAt describes when sources were actually checked; each job verifiedAt describes that job's evidence age.
policy.promotion: No timestamp-only freshness. New LIVE promotion requires active full-detail evidence, location eligibility, confidence >= 80 and no known hard eligibility gate.
policy.discovery: List/search resurfacing can create a candidate but never verifiedAt or LIVE promotion by itself.
policy.failClosed: Existing LIVE jobs are not removed merely because a sweep did not rediscover them. No unsafe write to jobs-data, job-sources or MASTER is attempted where full round-trip content cannot be guaranteed.
